description: A panel that slides in from any edge and can be swiped away, with snap points and a floating style.
overview:
`Drawer` presents content in a panel attached to an edge of the screen. It slides in from the bottom by default, or from the top, left or right with `swipeDirection`, and the user can drag it closed in that direction. The content renders through a portal (inside a full-window overlay on iOS) and respects the safe-area insets.

Set `floating` to inset the panel from the screen edges with all corners rounded. Use `snapPoints` to let a bottom drawer rest at several heights. Wrap your app in `DrawerProvider` and its screen in `DrawerIndent` to scale the page back behind an open bottom drawer.
usage:
Compose `DrawerTrigger` and `DrawerContent` with a `DrawerHeader` (`DrawerTitle`, `DrawerDescription`), your content and a `DrawerFooter`. Use `DrawerClose` to close it from a button.

Set `showSwipeHandle` to show a grab handle, and `showCloseButton` on the content for a corner close button, with `closeLabel` for a text button. `snapPoints` accepts fractions of the screen such as `[0.4, 1]`; control the current one with `snapPoint` and `onSnapPointChange`.

With `modal={false}` there is no scrim. For the scaled background, render `DrawerIndentBackground` behind a `DrawerIndent` inside `DrawerProvider`.

examples.SnapPoints: A drawer that rests at 40% and full height.
examples.Floating: A floating drawer inset from the edges.
examples.Sides: Drawers from the top, bottom, left and right.

parts.Drawer: Root that holds the open state, direction and snap points.
parts.DrawerPortal: Portal the content is rendered into.
parts.DrawerOverlay: Dimmed scrim behind a modal drawer.
parts.DrawerContent: Sliding panel with optional handle and close button.
parts.DrawerSwipeHandle: Grab handle on the dragging edge.
parts.DrawerHeader: Area for the title and description.
parts.DrawerTitle: Drawer heading, centered for top and bottom drawers.
parts.DrawerFooter: Area for actions at the end of the panel.
parts.DrawerProvider: Tracks open drawers for the indent effect.
parts.DrawerIndent: Screen wrapper that scales back while a bottom drawer is open.
parts.DrawerIndentBackground: Background shown behind the scaled screen.

Drawer.floating: Insets the panel from the edges.
Drawer.snapPoints: Heights the drawer can rest at.
Drawer.onSnapPointChange: Called when the snap point changes.
Drawer.disablePointerDismissal: Keeps the drawer open when the scrim is tapped.
Drawer.onOpenChange: Called when the drawer opens or closes.

DrawerContent.closeLabel: Text for the close button instead of the icon.
DrawerContent.portalHost: Name of the portal host to render into.

accessibility:
- The popup has the `dialog` role and is labelled by the title.
- The swipe handle and decorative edge fill are hidden from screen readers.
- The icon close button is labelled "Close".
notes:
- Padding follows the safe-area insets, and a docked drawer extends its background past the screen edge so drag overshoot shows no gap.
- Animations respect the system Reduce Motion setting.
- Uses `bg-surface-raised`, `bg-scrim` and `bg-label-quaternary` tokens; light and dark follow the system appearance.
